Good morning.

Please find below the rate breakdown for a three-month booking:

Upside Studio (Non-View Apartment) – Upside Living
July: AED 4,500
August: AED 5,000
September: AED 5,500

Burj View Apartment – Upside Living
July: AED 5,500
August: AED 6,000
September: AED 6,500

Please note that a security deposit of AED 1,500 will also be required. Each monthly booking will be for 30 nights only.

Kindly let us know if you require any further assistance.
